changes: Implemented the local Authority bundle generator so the default path emits lattice_authority_trust.env and lattice_staging-client.env, while the senior opt-in path emits the lattice_senior_* pair and preserves the legacy aliases.
usage: Run the bundle generation flow in the target workspace, source lattice_authority_trust.env plus lattice_staging-client.env for the normal path, and opt into the senior pair only when you need the stronger live runner path.
expectedOutcome: A developer can generate a basic trust bundle locally, keep the legacy aliases working, and later opt into senior live-only files without changing the default path.
actualTranscript: npm run build passed; authority-client-smoke passed for basic and senior bundles; authority-status-smoke passed; docs-drift-smoke passed; authority-completion-smoke passed; validate passed after the current branch sync.
outcomeDiff: Actual outcome matches the expected one: the ordinary bundle stays local and simple, legacy aliases keep working, and live-only receipt and gate variables remain separate.
limitations: No cross-host portability is promised; the generated files are intended for the target workspace and the stronger live runner path still needs its own trust inputs.
pitfalls: When source files or wording change, rerun validate before DONE so evidence freshness does not drift behind the current branch state.
